## GameModel component
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Constant Binding `Injects.GameModel`

### Description
Represents the state of each game as sent by the server in `responseData.GameMessage`. Made up of data which changes from game to game such as payout values or visible symbols.

Has no implementation within the package so is required to be implemented by the game project.

Should implement the interface `IBaseGameModel`.

### API

#### payout: number
Should contain the total payout of the game and will be logged out as part of the App Analytics in calls to `logging.logEndGameMetrics()`.

#### isNewPlayer: boolean
Internally set to true on a successful *Resume* request, if there is no gameMessage data in the response from the server.

Used to display the HTP to new players on mobile-web and apps then set to false.

#### setData(responseData: IBaseServerResponse): void
Should update the model data with new values from the ServerResponse.

Internally called during bootstrap on a successful *Resume* request. **Will not be called if there is no GameMessage data in the resume response**

Should be called by the game on any *Begin* or possibly *Continue* requests.

### BareBones Example
```ts
// file game-model.ts

import { IBaseGameModel, IBaseServerResponse } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

export class GameModel implements IBaseGameModel {
    public static get Instance(): GameModel { return this._instance || (this._instance = new GameModel()); }
    private static _instance: GameModel;

    public payout: number = 0;
    public isNewPlayer: boolean = false;
    public isComplete: boolean;
    public hasBonus: boolean;

    private constructor() { }

    public setData(responseData: IBaseServerResponse): void {
        this.payout = responseData.GameMessage.Payout;
    }
}

export const gameModel = GameModel.Instance;
```
